records.quote: 2, missus, r*s, m. [mitto], a sending  away, a sending, despatching. I, Lit. A

note: L&S 单列 2. missus, -us, m. [mitto] "a sending away, a sending, despatching"，并把 1. missus 标为 "Part., from mitto"，确认 miss- 是 mittere 的分词词干。
